Boralex Inc., together with Walpole Island First Nation, has commissioned the Sanjgon Battery Energy Storage facility in Lakeshore, Ontario, its first operational North American storage asset with 80 MW / 320 MWh of capacity. The project marks a key step in Boralex’s 2030 Strategy, expanding its large-scale storage footprint while embedding long-term Indigenous and municipal partnerships through a Community Benefit Agreement.
